required_upstream: D17 Asset/Inventory identity, condition, containment and history authority available

execution_design.one_continue_scope: One owner Continue carries the selected OARC tranche through bounded implementation, required validation, durable closeout and successor selection unless an OPS3 owner-only boundary or genuine external blocker is reached.
execution_design.preload_rule: Load only the selected OARC tranche and its declared dependency closure; block unrelated roadmap work.
execution_design.no_guess_rule: Unknown or source-unspecified operational, compatibility, topology, engineering, construction or salvage semantics remain unresolved.
execution_design.owner_boundary_rule: OARC closes bridges and readiness gaps through existing owners; it does not create replacement MRCS, MIB-14/D17, MERA or MBES runtimes.
